albums.blurb: Bright Size Life is guitarist Pat Metheny's debut, recorded for ECM in December 1975 when he was 21, in a trio with drummer Bob Moses and Jaco Pastorius, whose fretless electric bass gets its first major recording here. The eight instrumentals — no vocals of any kind — set out the liquid tone and open, Midwestern lyricism Metheny would build the Pat Metheny Group around, and the title track became a modern jazz standard.
albums.reception: Initial sales were modest, but the album is now widely regarded as a landmark debut, and Metheny himself chose the title track to open his 2004 Selected Recordings compilation in ECM's artist-curated :rarum series.

albums.blurb: Whitney is the Chicago duo of drummer-singer Julien Ehrlich and guitarist Max Kakacek, formed after the breakup of Smith Westerns. Forever Turned Around, released on Secretly Canadian in August 2019 and produced by Brad Cook and Jonathan Rado, is their second album, a set of ten falsetto-led, horn- and pedal-steel-tinged songs that follows their 2016 debut Light Upon the Lake.
albums.reception: The album holds a Metacritic score of 75 from 16 reviews, with positive notices outnumbering mixed ones twelve to four and several critics observing how closely it hews to the sound of the debut.

albums.album: Reachin' (A New Refutation of Time and Space)
albums.blurb: Digable Planets are the trio of Ishmael "Butterfly" Butler, Mariana "Ladybug Mecca" Vieira, and Craig "Doodlebug" Irving, who convened in Brooklyn and titled their debut after a Borges essay. Released on Pendulum/Elektra in February 1993, Reachin' builds its laid-back verses over samples of Art Blakey, Sonny Rollins, and Curtis Mayfield, a jazz-rap counterpart to A Tribe Called Quest and De La Soul; the harder-edged Blowout Comb followed in 1994 before the group split.
albums.reception: Its single "Rebirth of Slick (Cool Like Dat)" reached No. 15 on the Billboard Hot 100 and won the 1994 Grammy Award for Best Rap Performance by a Duo or Group, and the album was certified gold by the RIAA.
